text:
incidents-bot: HIGH PRIORITY: policy-eval-prod triggered pager (sev=1) — smart-routing evaluator panicked during rule compilation. Incident ID: INC-20260315-1932. Runbook: <https://runbook/redwood/incidents/policy-eval|policy-eval runbook>

maria.oncall: taking pager. I'm on it, jumping into logs and console.

jess.sre: seeing spikes in 5xxs for the routing API. Symptoms: requests bouncing between eu-west-1 <-> us-east-1, fallback rules retriggering then re-evaluating and flipping route -> routing loop. Dash: https://dash/re/routing/123 (errors spike at 19:05 UTC).

remy-support: FYI acme-corp reported errors starting ~19:05, flagged as P1 from support.

sachin-ml: dug into policy-eval logs. Panic comes from regexp compile error inside the policy expression evaluator. Snippet from evaluator logs: 
```
panic: regexp: missing closing ]
\tgoroutine 42 [running]:
\tgithub.com/redwood/policy/eval.(*Evaluator).Eval(0xc0000aa000, 0xc0001b6000)
\t\t/go/src/github.com/redwood/policy/eval/eval.go:142 +0x1a3
```

jess.sre: found the offending rule in the latest bundle (deployed 19:02):
```
# policy id: prefer_region
when request.headers["x-country"] =~ /^(US|CA|GB/ {
  route = "low-latency-variant"
}
```
(note: the regex is malformed — missing closing ) and ] mismatch)

maria.oncall: immediate mitigation: disabling policy evaluation so miscompiled expressions stop causing panics and the fallback loop can break. Executing control-plane toggle: `redwoodctl toggle policy-eval --env prod --state disabled --reason "panic during eval"`

deploy-bot: control-plane action executed: policy-eval service set to degraded mode; routing now uses configured safe-default variant for failed evaluations. CI link: https://ci/deploy/4567

dan.platform: confirming metrics — error rate fell from 3.9% to 0.2% within ~4 minutes of mitigation. Impact window observed: 19:05:20 -> 19:11:40 UTC. Affected requests: acme-corp ~420 failed requests; system-wide ~12k requests in window.

remy-support: notified acme-corp with interim status and mitigation. They want ETA for full restore and root cause.

maria.oncall: handing off to dan for remediation and postmortem. Dan, can you take the follow-up? I'll stay on the call for the rollout verification.

dan.platform: taking it. Plan: revert last policy bundle commit (commit 9f8c7b), add strict parse-time validation for regex/expressions, add unit tests, and ship a patch to the evaluator to avoid panics (return eval-errors instead). I'll open PR + hotfix release.

tao-prod-eng: pushed a defensive hotfix to the evaluator: if an expression compile fails, evaluator returns an EvalError and logs expression id instead of panicking. Patch: https://git/repo/patch/891 (hotfix branch).

jess.sre: implementing a circuit-breaker so a single failing policy expression doesn't flip routing globally. Also adding CI linting step to validate policy bundles before deploy.

maria.oncall: customer impact window and severity recorded. Closing pager for active alerts, moving to post-incident review.

incidents-bot: Incident INC-20260315-1932 moved to "mitigated" state. Owners: dan.platform, sachin-ml. Follow-up ticket created: RED-3456 (policy validation + rollout gating + evaluator hardening).

remy-support: final: acme-corp asked for a written postmortem and confirmation that no confidential data was exposed. We'll include timeline and RCA.

dan.platform: postmortem plan: root cause = malformed regex in policy bundle that bypassed validation; contributing factor = legacy bundles didn't run parse-time validation; mitigations = control-plane toggle, evaluator guard, CI linting, stricter rollout gating. Draft ETA: EOD.

maria.oncall: thanks everyone — great triage. :thumbsup:
